about: Deliberate differences between a tool-library tool and its twin under packs/*/tools. Empty: every twin is byte-equal. An entry is {tool, file, why, library_sha256, pack_sha256}; the digests are those of the two files as they differ today, so a changed side fails the entry until it is re-read, and an entry whose files are equal again fails as stale. The list only shrinks (tests/tool-library-twins.test.ts).

entries.why: the library copy was saved from a run and keeps the provenance record of its constants table; a pack ships no provenance file
the library copy was saved from a run and keeps that run's provenance record; a pack ships no provenance file
